FINAL RESULT — полный протокол выполнен (main + dedup sensitivity), все три поправки учтены.

RESULTS TABLE (jailed − no-jail; primary = one-sided MWU, H1: jailed < no-jail; bootstrap 10k)

MAIN (n1=289, n0=11,724):
1985* | mean: 7,929 vs 25,086 → Δ=−17,157 CI[−20,397,−13,604]; wins. Δ=−13,086 CI[−15,854,−9,760]; median: 720 vs 3,600 → Δ=−2,880, HL=−1,160, CI[−3,600,−2,300]; MWU p=8.0e-11; Welch raw 6.3e-21 / wins 9.3e-16; Cliff δ=−0.218
1990  | mean: 16,350 vs 73,948 → Δ=−57,598 CI[−67,450,−44,598]; wins. Δ=−50,815 CI[−58,388,−41,318]; median: 0 vs 10,500 → Δ=−10,500, HL=−8,000, CI[−11,100,−10,000]; MWU p=3.9e-35; Welch 1.6e-19 / 8.8e-27; Cliff δ=−0.420
1996  | mean: 20,383 vs 105,447 → Δ=−85,063 CI[−98,428,−64,603]; wins. Δ=−80,884 CI[−90,293,−67,715]; median: 0 vs 8,500 → Δ=−8,500, HL=−6,000, CI[−10,000,−7,225]; MWU p=4.6e-26; Welch 7.3e-20 / 7.7e-35; Cliff δ=−0.351

DEDUP SENSITIVITY (drop_duplicates по всем 6 колонкам; 12,013→10,114; n1=239, n0=9,875):
1985: Δmean=−20,220 CI[−24,150,−15,920]; Δmedian=−4,600 CI[−5,300,−3,587]; MWU p=1.6e-13; Cliff δ=−0.275
1990: Δmean=−68,032; Δmedian=−18,700 CI[−20,000,−17,000]; MWU p=6.3e-42; Cliff δ=−0.510
1996: Δmean=−100,518; Δmedian=−23,700 CI[−26,100,−21,500]; MWU p=4.9e-30; Cliff δ=−0.424
→ Набор значимых лет НЕ меняется (все 3 года в обеих спецификациях); эффекты после дедупа даже чуть СИЛЬНЕЕ (в т.ч. Cliff's delta растёт). Дубли не создавали ложной значимости — вывод, а не сноска, как просили.

MEAN vs MEDIAN direction: расхождения НЕТ — mean-based (raw и winsorized) и median/HL-based оценки отрицательны во всех годах в обеих спецификациях; winsorization не меняет знак/значимость, только масштаб. Величина mean-разрыва растёт к 1996 (номин. доллары), median-разрыв максимален в 1990/1996 при медиане 0 у jailed.

CONFOUNDING SCALE (jail share % по race×sex): black male 9.76 (143/1465), hipanic male 5.68, white male 1.64, black female 1.03, hipanic female 0.91, white female 0.33. Маргинально: race black 5.28 / hipanic 3.21 / white 0.97; male 4.31 / female 0.60. Тюрьма сильно сконцентрирована в black male → race/sex — потенциально сильные конфаундеры (в primary не включены по договорённости).

CAUSAL CAVEAT по 1985: окно jail 1985–1994 пересекается с измерением богатства 1985 → 1985 частично pre-treatment; статистическая значимость остаётся в силе, но 1985 нельзя читать как «incarceration reduced wealth». 1990 и 1996 — post-window.

ANSWER (hypothesis, естественный язык, с перечислением лет):
"Individuals with a criminal record (ever jailed 1985–1994) had significantly lower composite wealth than those without in all three surveyed years — 1985, 1990, and 1996. Statistically, the gap is significant in every year (one-sided Mann–Whitney p ≈ 8e-11, 3.9e-35, 4.6e-26; bootstrap 95% CIs for both mean and median differences exclude zero; Cliff's delta −0.22 to −0.42), and the result is robust to removing 1,899 duplicate rows and to winsorizing millionaire-driven outliers, with mean- and median-based estimates agreeing in direction. Interpreting this as a post-incarceration wealth penalty is only defensible for 1990 and 1996, which follow the jail window; the 1985 difference partially precedes it and should be read as a pre-/coinciding gap (lower-wealth individuals being more likely to be jailed), not as evidence that incarceration reduced wealth in 1985. The wealth gap is largest in absolute nominal terms in 1996, while relative/rank-based effects peak in 1990. Comparisons are unadjusted; jail rates concentrate among black males (9.8% vs 0.3% white females), so race/sex confounding likely accounts for part of the gap."

payload.hypothesis: Individuals with a criminal record (ever jailed 1985-1994) had significantly lower composite wealth than those without in all three surveyed years (1985, 1990, 1996): one-sided Mann-Whitney p = 8.0e-11, 3.9e-35, 4.6e-26; bootstrap 95% CIs for both mean and median differences exclude zero in every year; Cliff's delta -0.22 to -0.42; robust to deduplication and winsorization with mean- and median-based estimates agreeing in sign. The post-window interpretation (wealth penalty of incarceration) is defensible only for 1990 and 1996; 1985 is partially pre-treatment and reflects a pre-existing wealth gap. Absolute nominal gap is largest in 1996, rank-based effect strongest in 1990. Comparisons are unadjusted and jail concentration among black males implies likely race/sex confounding.
payload.workflow: Load CSV (12,013x6) -> descriptives by group/year -> primary one-sided MWU + Hodges-Lehmann + 10k bootstrap CIs for median and mean diffs -> secondary Welch t on raw and 1/99% winsorized -> Cliff's delta & rank-biserial -> dedup sensitivity run (drop_duplicates on all columns, 10,114 rows) with identical protocol -> race x sex jail-share confounding table -> results_table.csv + natural-language hypothesis
